toolDefinitions.name: read-docx
toolDefinitions.description: Read a Word file (.docx): its paragraphs with their index, and its tables. Use the index with edit-docx.

path.description: The file, as a path inside the user's files, such as /reports/plan.docx.

toolDefinitions.name: read-xlsx
toolDefinitions.description: Read an Excel file (.xlsx): the sheet names and the cell values of each sheet, row by row. Give sheet to read one sheet.

path.description: The file, as a path inside the user's files, such as /reports/plan.xlsx.

sheet.description: The name of one sheet. Default: all sheets.

toolDefinitions.name: read-pptx
toolDefinitions.description: Read a PowerPoint file (.pptx): each slide with its title and its text shapes (id, kind, paragraphs). Use the shape id with edit-pptx.

path.description: The file, as a path inside the user's files, such as /reports/plan.pptx.

toolDefinitions.name: read-pdf
toolDefinitions.description: Read the text of a PDF file (.pdf), page by page. A scanned page without text gives no text.

lastPage.description: Last page. Default: the end, up to 50 pages.

path.description: The file, as a path inside the user's files, such as /reports/plan.pdf.

toolDefinitions.name: edit-docx
toolDefinitions.description: Change a Word file in place. Edits run in order and all or none are saved. Read the file first to get paragraph indexes. If someone changed the file meanwhile, your version is saved as a second file.

after.description: insert: insert after this paragraph index; -1 for the start.

find.description: replace: the text to look for, everywhere.

index.description: set and delete: the paragraph index.

style.description: insert: a paragraph style the document defines. Optional.

text.description: set and insert: the new text. replace: the text to put in.

path.description: The file, as a path inside the user's files, such as /reports/plan.docx.

toolDefinitions.name: edit-xlsx
toolDefinitions.description: Change an Excel file in place. Give sheet and cells; each cell has a ref such as B3 and exactly one of text, number, formula (such as =SUM(B2:B9)) or clear. addSheet adds an empty sheet first.

addSheet.description: The name of a sheet to add before the cells are set. Optional.

cells.description: The cells to change, at most 200.

formula.description: Set the cell to this formula.

number.description: Set the cell to this number.

text.description: Set the cell to this text.

path.description: The file, as a path inside the user's files, such as /reports/plan.xlsx.

sheet.description: The sheet the cells belong to.

toolDefinitions.name: edit-pptx
toolDefinitions.description: Change a PowerPoint file in place. Ops: title (slide, text), text (slide, shape id, paragraph, text), add (text is the title, bullets, optional layout), delete (slide). Read the file first for ids.

layout.description: add: the layout name. Default Title and Content.

paragraph.description: text: the paragraph number in the shape, from 0.

shape.description: text: the shape id from read-pptx.

text.description: The new text, or for add the new slide's title.

path.description: The file, as a path inside the user's files, such as /reports/plan.pptx.

toolDefinitions.name: create-docx
toolDefinitions.description: Create a Word document from Markdown. Supports headings, paragraphs, lists, bold, italic and simple tables. If the path is taken, the old file stays and the new one is saved next to it.

path.description: The file, as a path inside the user's files, such as /reports/plan.docx.

title.description: Optional title metadata; does not add a heading.

toolDefinitions.name: create-xlsx
toolDefinitions.description: Create one Excel sheet from comma-separated CSV. Every nonempty value is text, never a formula or number. Sheet defaults to Sheet1. If the path is taken, the old file stays and the new one is saved next to it.

path.description: The file, as a path inside the user's files, such as /reports/plan.xlsx.

sheet.description: The sheet name. Optional; defaults to Sheet1.

title.description: Optional title metadata; does not add a heading.

toolDefinitions.name: create-pptx
toolDefinitions.description: Create a PowerPoint file from slides, each with a title and bullet lines. A slide without bullets is a title slide. If the path is taken, the old file stays and the new one is saved next to it.

path.description: The file, as a path inside the user's files, such as /reports/plan.pptx.

toolDefinitions.name: create-pdf
toolDefinitions.description: Create a PDF from Markdown headings, paragraphs, lists, bold, italic and simple tables. Text must use Latin-1 characters only. If the path is taken, the old file stays and the new one is saved next to it.

path.description: The file, as a path inside the user's files, such as /reports/plan.pdf.

title.description: Optional title metadata; does not add a heading.

description.en: Lightweight basic Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF file work from your chats, without requiring Sandbox.
description.it: Lavoro leggero e di base su file Word, Excel, PowerPoint e PDF dalle tue chat, senza richiedere Sandbox.
description.de: Einfache Arbeit mit Word-, Excel-, PowerPoint- und PDF-Dateien direkt aus Ihren Chats, ohne dass Sandbox nötig ist.
description.es: Trabajo ligero y básico con archivos de Word, Excel, PowerPoint y PDF desde tus chats, sin necesidad de Sandbox.
description.fr: Travail léger et de base sur des fichiers Word, Excel, PowerPoint et PDF depuis vos conversations, sans avoir besoin de Sandbox.
description.pt-BR: Trabalho leve e básico com arquivos Word, Excel, PowerPoint e PDF a partir dos seus chats, sem precisar do Sandbox.
description.zh-CN: 在聊天中轻量地处理基础的 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 和 PDF 文件，无需 Sandbox。
description.ko: Sandbox 없이도 채팅에서 Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF 파일의 기본 작업을 가볍게 처리합니다.
description.id: Pekerjaan ringan dan dasar dengan berkas Word, Excel, PowerPoint, dan PDF dari obrolan Anda, tanpa memerlukan Sandbox.
